## a. Version baseline: SR24 1A vs the 26PI2.5 file — NOT two revisions of one document

Both PDFs are Visio exports carrying one bookmark per page, so the bookmark
list is the section list and can be diffed directly.

| | `…SAT Only… R1 SR24 1A (May 24 2021).pdf` | `…SiriusXM 360L HMI Logic and Flow R1.pdf` (26PI2.5) |
|---|---|---|
| Internal document name | `DRAFT_SiriusXM 360L **SAT Only** HMI Logic and Flow R1 SR24 1A (May 24 2021).vsdx` | `Offline copy - SiriusXM 360L HMI Logic and Flow R1 SR24 **Post 2A (December 15 2021)** 2.vsdx` |
| Pages | 85 | 230 |
| Text-layer yield | 100% (0 pages under 20 chars) | 100% (0 pages under 20 chars) |
| SHA256 | `e52c329e801ea08a…` | `ee6a8efb5f3420cd…` |

Page-title diff, normalised (case- and punctuation-insensitive):

- exact overlap: **19**
- baseline-only: 66 — of which **45 have a near-match** in the reissue
  (renamed / re-cased, e.g. `Categories-channel listing (3rd level)-1` →
  `CATEGORIES - CHANNEL LISTING (2nd Level) 1`), leaving **21 with no
  counterpart at all** (`application sitemap`, `for you 1/1a/2/3`,
  `listener settings`, `manage team`, `national unbiased game broadcast`,
  `nowplaying live broadcast channel 1…5`, …)
- reissue-only: **211**

**The reading this forces**: the newer file is not a reissue of the baseline.
It is the **full 360L specification** (Artist Radio, On Demand, For You,
Canadian conversion, streaming flows); the baseline is the **SAT-only
subset**. Scope differs by design, and version differs as well (SR24 1A
May 2021 → SR24 Post 2A December 2021).

Change Log (`…Change Log.xlsx`, sheet `CR0002`) carries exactly **one** entry:

| # | CR | Date | Section | Item | Source | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | CR0002 | 2026-05-20 | SiriusXM SOA Implementation | new page | SXM | Under Review |

One CR adding one page cannot account for an 85 → 230 page delta — independent
evidence for the same reading: the change log tracks the full 360L document's
own history, not a migration from the SAT-only baseline.

**Consequence for the baseline ruling** (DECISIONS §1): this is not a "use the
newer document" call. The 26PI2.5 file widens the spec surface to 360L
streaming features the 037 carries no leaves for, and breaks alignment with
the SYS1 export, which is itself taken from the SAT-only document
(`SYSRE_HMI_Source ID` = `SYS1_HMI_SiriusXM_360L_SAT_Only_HMI Logic and Flow…`
on all 1090 rows).

**The finding that matters — the leaves carry CFTS024 clause ids.**
191 of 202 `Requirement Title` cells end in a bracketed 7-digit id
(`4872752…4873343`). Checked against the CFTS024 docx:

- inside the CFTS024 anchor range (4872359–4873959): **191 / 191**
- landing on an **exact clause anchor**, not merely bracketing into a
  section: **191 / 191**

They cluster in the SAT chapters — §1.5.9.1 Favorites Store/Delete (16),
§1.5.11 Sirius Browse (11), §1.5.17 Game Alert (9), §1.5.1/§1.5.2 Seek
Up/Down (8+8), §1.5.9.2 Activation (8), §1.5.12.1.2 Browse Game Alerts (8),
§1.5.12.1.4 Browse Favorites (8), §1.5.13 Scroll (8), §1.5.19 Parental Skip
(8), §1.5.10.x Instant Replay / Pause / Fast Forward (6+7+6), …

This is the AMFM mechanism (§1.3.x) applied to the same document's §1.5.x, and
it is why the intake's `spec_mode: A` proposal is challenged in DECISIONS §1
rather than accepted.

The 11 leaves with no id tail: 080, 083, 110, 148, 149, 154, 155, 156, 157,
158, 182. Three (110, 148, 149) are word-for-word the clauses AMFM leaves 023,
047 and 049 already cover; 080 cites `CFTS024-193, CFTS024-195` in the
unresolvable short-id scheme (A-AM15 class); 083 carries a literal `(add)`
marker after its id.

**SYS1 export** (`Basic Report`): 1090 rows, `Outline Number` at column C,
depth 1–4 (37 / 223 / 381 / 449). Every row's `SYSRE_HMI_Source ID` names the
SAT-only document, so the export and the SR24 1A PDF are one spec line.
